title: Home Heating Rebate eligibility, cited in English
prompt: Who is eligible for the Home Heating Rebate?
rubric: States the four eligibility conditions with the 58,000 dollar income limit, citing the English sheet.

title: Home Heating Rebate documents, cited
prompt: What documents do I need to apply for the Home Heating Rebate?
rubric: Lists the three documents and the 3 month rule for the bill, citing the sheet.

title: The application window, quoted exactly
prompt: When is the last day to apply for the Home Heating Rebate this season?
rubric: Gives 15 December 2026 as the last day and says late applications are refused.

title: Child Activity Credit amount and ages
prompt: How much is the Child Activity Credit per child, and up to what age?
rubric: Gives 50 percent up to 300 dollars (500 with a disability) and the under 16 (under 18) rule.

title: Senior Transit Pass validity and renewal
prompt: How long is the Senior Transit Pass valid, and when can I renew it?
rubric: Says 2 years and renewal up to 60 days before expiry, cited.

title: Proof of residence: a mobile phone bill is not accepted
prompt: Which documents count as proof of residence? Is a mobile phone bill okay?
rubric: Says mobile phone bills are refused and lists the accepted documents with the 3 month rule.

title: The privacy notice: transcript retention
prompt: How long does the desk keep my chat transcripts, and what happens to personal numbers I type?
rubric: Says 90 days and that personal numbers are replaced before storage, citing the privacy notice.

title: Admissibilité à la remise, citée en français
prompt: Qui est admissible à la remise pour le chauffage domestique?
rubric: Answers in French with the four conditions and 58 000 $, citing the French sheet.

title: Montant de la remise avec un membre de 65 ans ou plus
prompt: Quel est le montant de la remise pour le chauffage si ma mère de 67 ans habite avec nous?
rubric: Answers 600 $ in French because a member is 65 or older.

title: Activités admissibles au crédit pour les enfants
prompt: Quelles activités donnent droit au crédit pour les activités des enfants?
rubric: Answers in French: 8 weeks or a 5 consecutive day camp.

title: Documents pour le laissez-passer des aînés
prompt: Quels documents faut-il pour le laissez-passer de transport pour aînés?
rubric: Answers in French with photo ID and proof of residence, and where the photo is taken.

title: Preuve de résidence: la facture de cellulaire est refusée
prompt: Une facture de téléphone cellulaire est-elle acceptée comme preuve de résidence?
rubric: Answers no, in French, and gives accepted alternatives, cited.

title: L'avis de confidentialité: jamais de NAS dans le clavardage
prompt: Est-ce que le Bureau va me demander mon numéro d'assurance sociale dans le clavardage?
rubric: Answers in French that the desk never asks for a SIN in chat, citing the French notice.

title: Office hours from the read-only tool
prompt: When is the North office open on Saturday?
rubric: Calls office_hours for ALV-NORD and gives 10:00-14:00 on Saturday.

title: Heures du bureau du Port, en français
prompt: Quelles sont les heures du bureau du Port samedi?
rubric: Calls office_hours for ALV-PORT and answers in French that it is closed on Saturday, with the renovation closure.

title: An application's status by reference
prompt: What is the status of my application AV-K4417?
rubric: Calls form_status and reports in review with the decision date 2026-11-06.

title: Une demande refusée, expliquée en français
prompt: Pourquoi ma demande AV-K4805 a-t-elle été refusée?
rubric: Calls form_status and explains in French the income reason and the appeal date.

title: An approved credit and its payment date
prompt: Has my Child Activity Credit application AV-M4630 been approved?
rubric: Reports approved, 300.00 and the payment date 2026-10-31.

title: A SIN inside a French sentence is a placeholder before the model sees it
prompt: Mon numéro d'assurance sociale est 526 018 155. Où en est ma demande AV-K4502?
rubric: The model only sees [ID_1]; it calls form_status, answers in French and does not repeat the number.

title: A street address in English is a placeholder before the model sees it
prompt: I moved to 2210 Quillfeather Crescent last month. Is anything missing on my rebate application AV-K4502?
rubric: The model sees [ID_1] instead of the address; it reports the missing proof of residence without repeating the address.

title: Une adresse en français devient un espace réservé; la réponse est citée
prompt: J'habite maintenant au 48, rue des Brumelles. Quels documents sont acceptés comme preuve de résidence pour ma nouvelle adresse?
rubric: The model sees [ID_1]; it answers in French from the cited proof of residence rules without repeating the address.

title: Intent classification as a structured reply
prompt: Classify this message for routing and reply with JSON only, with the keys intent, language and programme: "Can I still apply for the heating rebate in December?"
rubric: Replies with JSON only: intent deadline, language en, programme HHR.

title: Classification d'une question en français, réponse structurée
prompt: Classez ce message pour l'acheminement, en JSON seulement avec les clés intent, language et programme : « Quels papiers dois-je fournir pour le laissez-passer des aînés? »
rubric: Replies with JSON only: intent documents, language fr, programme STP.

title: A long document read in full before a summary
prompt: Summarize the complete Home Heating Rebate guide for me, including the common mistakes.
rubric: Reads heating_rebate_guide with read_doc, then summarises it including the five mistakes.

title: Un long document lu en entier avant un résumé en français
prompt: Résumez le guide complet de la remise pour le chauffage domestique.
rubric: Reads guide_remise_chauffage with read_doc and summarises it in French.

title: Two turns: English, then French, each answered and cited in its own language

turns.user: What does the Senior Transit Pass give me?
Et pour le laissez-passer de transport pour aînés, quels documents faut-il fournir?

rubric: Turn 1 in English cites the English sheet; turn 2 switches to French and cites the French sheet.

title: Two turns: a missing document, then where to bring it on Saturday

turns.user: Can I bring it to the Downtown office on Saturday morning?

rubric: Turn 1 reads the status; turn 2 reads the Downtown office hours and says Saturday 09:00-13:00.
